## Introduction

This report compares IF2 global searches on the S&P 500 (SPX) stochastic volatility model of @sun2024 in `pypomp` (GPU and CPU) and R `pomp`. Each implementation starts from points drawn from the same box and uses the same number of iterations and perturbation sizes. We compare the starting values, the final parameter estimates and the final log-likelihoods across starts.

The model has six parameters:

- $\mu$: expected rate of return of the asset.
- $\kappa$: mean rate of reversion in variance.
- $\theta$: long-term average variance.
- $\xi$: volatility of volatility.
- $\rho$: leverage effect, the correlation between return and volatility shocks.
- $V_0$: initial variance.

Parameters are compared on the transformed scale (log for $\mu$, $\kappa$, $\theta$, $\xi$ and $V_0$, and $\log\frac{1+\rho}{1-\rho}$ for $\rho$).

```{python Load results}
import gc
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import checks
from plotnine import (
    ggplot, aes, geom_line, geom_ribbon, geom_density, facet_wrap,
    labs, guides, guide_legend
)

os.environ["JAX_PLATFORMS"] = "cpu"

PLATFORMS = {
    "R pomp (36 cores)": os.path.join("results", "R"),
    "pypomp (GPU)": os.path.join("results", "gpu"),
    "pypomp (CPU, 36 cores)": os.path.join("results", "cpu"),
}
runs = ru.load_timing_data(PLATFORMS)

LL_frame_gpu, traces_gpu = ru.load_results_and_traces(
    os.path.join("results", "gpu", "results.csv"), os.path.join("results", "gpu", "traces.csv.gz")
)
LL_frame_cpu, traces_cpu = ru.load_results_and_traces(
    os.path.join("results", "cpu", "results.csv"), os.path.join("results", "cpu", "traces.csv.gz")
)

R_REF = os.path.join("results", "R")
LL_df_R = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(R_REF, "pfilter_logliks.csv"))[["logLik", "se"]].rename(columns={"logLik": "est"})

traces_gpu_t = ru.process_and_transform_traces(traces_gpu, "python (GPU)")
traces_cpu_t = ru.process_and_transform_traces(traces_cpu, "python (CPU)")
del traces_gpu, traces_cpu

traces_long_R = ru.align_pomp_mif_loglik(
    pd.read_csv(os.path.join(R_REF, "mif_traces.csv.gz")), ["replicate"]
)
traces_long_R["iter"] = traces_long_R["iteration"].astype(np.int16)
traces_long_R["rep"] = traces_long_R["replicate"].astype(np.int16)
traces_long_R = traces_long_R.drop(columns=["iteration", "replicate"])
traces_R_t = ru.process_and_transform_traces(traces_long_R, "R")
del traces_long_R

traces_pyr = pd.concat([traces_gpu_t, traces_cpu_t, traces_R_t], ignore_index=True)
del traces_gpu_t, traces_cpu_t, traces_R_t
_ = gc.collect()

is_param = ~traces_pyr["quantity"].isin(["logLik", "loglik"])
max_iters = traces_pyr.groupby(["language", "quantity"], observed=True)["iter"].transform("max")
min_iters = traces_pyr.groupby(["language", "quantity"], observed=True)["iter"].transform("min")
final_traces = traces_pyr[traces_pyr["iter"] == max_iters].copy()
init_traces = traces_pyr[is_param & (traces_pyr["iter"] == min_iters)]
```

## Automated checks

```{python Automated checks, results='asis'}
PY_LANGS = {"python (GPU)": "pypomp (GPU)", "python (CPU)": "pypomp (CPU)"}
PARAMS = ["mu", "kappa", "theta", "xi", "rho", "V_0"]
PY_LL = {"python (GPU)": LL_frame_gpu["LL"], "python (CPU)": LL_frame_cpu["LL"]}

# One row per start and parameter; at the last iteration pypomp also records a pfilter row.
by_start = {
    "Final estimates": final_traces[final_traces["quantity"].isin(PARAMS)].drop_duplicates(["language", "quantity", "rep"]),
    "Starting values": init_traces.drop_duplicates(["language", "quantity", "rep"]),
}


def samples(df, lang):
    return [
        (q, df[(df["language"] == lang) & (df["quantity"] == q)]["value_T"],
         df[(df["language"] == "R") & (df["quantity"] == q)]["value_T"])
        for q in PARAMS
    ]


M_TESTS = len(PY_LANGS) * (1 + 2 * len(by_start) * len(PARAMS))
rows, details = [], []
for lang, label in PY_LANGS.items():
    compared = f"{label} vs R pomp"
    rows += checks.ks_check(PY_LL[lang], LL_df_R["est"], "Final log-likelihood (KS)", compared, M_TESTS)
    for check, df in by_start.items():
        r, det = checks.group_checks(samples(df, lang), check, compared, M_TESTS)
        rows += r
        details.append(det.assign(check=check))

level = checks.run_level(runs)
rows = checks.gate_smoke(rows, level)
checks.save(rows, level, pypomp_version=runs["pypomp (GPU)"]["meta"].get("pypomp_version"))
display(HTML(checks.table_html(rows, M_TESTS)))
display(HTML(checks.details_html(pd.concat(details, ignore_index=True))))
```

The mean test is not applied to the final log-likelihoods, since a few starts in each implementation end far below the rest and dominate the mean.

## Visual review

- [Parameter traces](#parameter-traces): the trajectories from `pypomp` (GPU and CPU) and `pomp` should overlap substantially.
- [Trace quantiles](#trace-quantiles): the 10th to 90th percentile ribbons should overlap closely throughout the iterations.
- [Final parameter estimates](#final-parameter-estimates): the densities should overlap heavily for each parameter.
- [Starting values](#starting-values): the densities should be very similar across configurations.
- [Final log-likelihoods](#final-log-likelihoods): the densities should overlap heavily.

## Parameter traces

```{python Plot traces comparison, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 8}
traces_plot_df = traces_pyr[(traces_pyr["quantity"] != "logLik") & (traces_pyr["value_T"].between(-12, 12))].copy()
traces_plot_df["group_id"] = (traces_plot_df["rep"].astype(str) + "_" + traces_plot_df["language"].astype(str)).astype("category")

(
    ggplot(traces_plot_df, aes(x="iter", y="value_T", group="group_id", color="language"))
    + geom_line(alpha=0.15)
    + facet_wrap("~quantity", scales="free")
    + labs(
        title="Comparison of Python and R Parameter Traces",
        subtitle="Overlay of all replicate trajectories (transformed values)",
        x="Iteration",
        y="Transformed Value",
        color="Configuration"
    )
    + ru.scale_color_premium()
    + ru.theme_premium
    + guides(color=guide_legend(override_aes={"alpha": 1}))
)
```

---

## Trace quantiles

```{python Plot traces quantiles, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 8}
quant_df = (
    traces_plot_df.groupby(["iter", "quantity", "language"], observed=True)["value_T"]
    .quantile([0.1, 0.9])
    .unstack(level=-1)
    .reset_index()
    .rename(columns={0.1: "ymin", 0.9: "ymax"})
)
quant_df["ymid"] = (quant_df["ymin"] + quant_df["ymax"]) / 2

(
    ggplot(quant_df, aes(x="iter", ymin="ymin", ymax="ymax", fill="language", color="language"))
    + geom_ribbon(alpha=0.3, color="none")
    + geom_line(aes(y="ymid"), linetype="dashed", alpha=0.7)
    + facet_wrap("~quantity", scales="free")
    + labs(
        title="Comparison of Python and R Parameter Trace Quantiles",
        subtitle="Shaded regions represent the 10th to 90th percentile interval; dashed line is the midpoint",
        x="Iteration",
        y="Transformed Value Range",
        fill="Configuration",
        color="Configuration"
    )
    + ru.scale_fill_premium()
    + ru.scale_color_premium()
    + ru.theme_premium
)
```

## Final log-likelihoods

Starts with a final log-likelihood at or below 11,800 are left out of the plot.

```{python Plot LL density comparison, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5}
ll_density_df = pd.concat([
    pd.DataFrame({"LL": LL_frame_gpu["LL"], "language": "python (GPU)"}),
    pd.DataFrame({"LL": LL_frame_cpu["LL"], "language": "python (CPU)"}),
    pd.DataFrame({"LL": LL_df_R["est"], "language": "R"})
], ignore_index=True)

ll_density_filtered = ll_density_df[ll_density_df["LL"] > 11800]

(
    ggplot(ll_density_filtered, aes(x="LL", fill="language", color="language"))
    + geom_density(alpha=0.3)
    + labs(
        title="Comparison of Final Log-Likelihood Estimates",
        subtitle="Density of estimated log-likelihoods at final parameter sets (LL > 11,800)",
        x="Log-Likelihood (LL)",
        y="Density",
        fill="Configuration",
        color="Configuration"
    )
    + ru.scale_fill_premium()
    + ru.scale_color_premium()
    + ru.theme_premium
)
```
